name: codex-arena
description: Bounded adversarial review-and-revise loop between Claude Code and the OpenAI Codex CLI, for any artifact (a synthetic dataset, a plan, a diff, a config). Codex critiques read-only and proposes fixes as text, Claude (or you) decides what's worth acting on, and the loop runs automatically until Codex approves or a round/token budget runs out. Includes a standalone script (arena.sh) that runs the whole loop without Claude in the room, taking your criteria in plain English.
